mainEntity.name: What should be expected before the surgery?

acceptedAnswer.text: The surgery is very severe and you will be restricted from eating or drinking after midnight before the surgery. Several medicines like aspirin will be restricted as it clots the blood.
During heart surgery, the cardiologists will make an access through the breastbone and extend the ribs to operate the heart.

mainEntity.name: How long is the surgery conducted?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of the surgery depends on how severe the problem is. For instance, the coronary artery bypass surgery is conducted for about 3 to 6 hours.

mainEntity.name: What are the restrictions after the surgery?

acceptedAnswer.text: You cannot do any heavy household chores at home. Activities like walking or taking the stairs will be restricted for a few months after surgery. Shouting will be completely limited as it can affect the heart.

mainEntity.name: Can someone do exercise after the surgery?

acceptedAnswer.text: After heart surgery, you may wonder if exercising is safe. However, exercising and staying fit can strengthen your body and help you stay healthier.
